verdict.rationale: BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is first-party documented as a data exchange platform for securely sharing and accessing data across organizational boundaries without replicating it. Listings share data without copies and can be monetized on Google Cloud Marketplace, so no export pipeline is needed. missing for 10: explicit documentation that consumers see live, up-to-date data and of the cross-account subscription mechanics, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can share live datasets with another account or organization without copying data or building an export pipeline

citations.quote: BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is a data exchange platform that lets you securely share, discover, and access data across organizational boundaries without replicating data.
Listings let you share data without replicating data, and you can monetize listings on Google Cloud Marketplace
